Citan
"Elly! Emeralda! I found
a service route around
the sealed lift.
I am going with you."<New>ZEBOIM DEFENSE UNIT ZD-808
CENTRAL CONTROL GUARDIAN<New>Citan
"It has sealed the terminal.
Stay together!"<New>Emeralda
"Citan came! Now there are
three of us."<New>Citan
"Four thousand years later,
it still obeys its final
military order."<New>ZD-808
"Launch control is a
military asset."<New>ZD-808
"Directive 0320 is void
under emergency law.
Withdraw or be terminated."<New>ZD-808
"Human command authority
expired four thousand
years ago."<New>ZD-808
"Autonomous defense remains
in force. Target lock
complete."<New>Elly
"It is overriding our
authorization!"<New>Citan
"Its barrier draws power
from the rail capacitors."<New>Emeralda
"Emeralda protects Elly
and Citan!"<New>Citan
"When the capacitors
discharge, its barrier
will fall."<New>Citan
"Strike the core together.
We must keep it from
the terminal!"<Close>
